AI.tldr: VEDAL 将 3D Gaussian Splatting 剪枝定义为变分自由能最小化，通过异步误差门控与不确定性头实现异构收敛感知的稀疏化。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有剪枝依赖启发式评分或同步批量更新，压缩次优且训练不稳定。
2. 各高斯因视角相关梯度呈现异质收敛，统一时序触发剪枝不合理。
AI.method:
1. 核心思路：将剪枝建模为随机隐变量（伯努利保留决策）的证据下界优化，以信息论视角平衡重建保真与模型复杂度。
2. 引入预测误差门控：依据每高斯的指数滑动平均离群重要性，异步激活剪枝资格，确保决策信号稳定后再施加变分压力。
3. 设计变分不确定性头：轻量 MLP 输出保留概率，采用 Binary Concrete 松弛与退火，并在训练全程计算梯度以预条件未激活高斯。
4. 保留-误差对应定理：在门控 ELBO 下最优保留概率为重要性/KL 权重比的 sigmoid，从理论上关联误差与稀疏化决策。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples、Deep Blending 三大基准上进行新视角合成评估，实现高压缩比（约 5.2 倍）下 PSNR 损失极小，超越 LightGaussian 与 PUP 3D-GS 等基线，并保持实时渲染帧率。
AI.conclusion:
1. 核心价值：首次将收敛条件变分推理引入 3DGS 剪枝，异步门控解决了异质收敛带来的剪枝时机难题。
2. 关键限制：理论推导采用独立的逐高斯假设，忽略透射耦合，导致 ELBO 近似可能存在保守偏差；实际影响为延迟剪枝，但理论误差界未分析。
3. 方法论洞见：把“何时剪”作为推理问题与“是否剪”联合优化是本质新意；变分框架使剪枝压力自然随不确定性衰减，可推广至其他动态结构学习任务。

title: MASER: Modality-Adaptive Specialist Routing for Embodied 3D Spatial Intelligence
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Foundation Models Meet Embodied Agents Workshop
summary: In 3D environments, Embodied Agents answer spatially relevant questions through reasoning from a mixture of modalities including natural language, RGB images, point clouds, depth maps and camera poses. Existing Vision-Language models (VLMs) are fine-tuned over a single modality. This completely ignores the question semantics which may favor a different modality than the finetuned modality. To address this, we propose MASER (Modality-Adaptive SpEcialist Routing), a lightweight framework that trains five different modality adapters of a shared VLM backbone and learns a neural routing policy that selects the best adapter based on the question during inference. We encode each question with a frozen sentence transformer and pass the embedding through a small Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on oracle adapter-accuracy labels. We evaluate our methodology over the Open3D-VQA benchmark and our evaluations show that no single modality is universally optimal -- point-cloud answers are best in 51.5% of cases. MASER routes with 51.3% oracle agreement, outperforming a Random-Forest ablation (43.5%), with only a single adapter call per question.
full_text: In 3D environments, Embodied Agents answer spatially relevant questions through reasoning from a mixture of modalities including natural language, RGB images, point clouds, depth maps and camera poses. Existing Vision-Language models (VLMs) are fine-tuned over a single modality. This completely ignores the question semantics which may favor a different modality than the finetuned modality. To address this, we propose MASER (Modality-Adaptive SpEcialist Routing), a lightweight framework that trains five different modality adapters of a shared VLM backbone and learns a neural routing policy that selects the best adapter based on the question during inference. We encode each question with a frozen sentence transformer and pass the embedding through a small Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on oracle adapter-accuracy labels. We evaluate our methodology over the Open3D-VQA benchmark and our evaluations show that no single modality is universally optimal -- point-cloud answers are best in 51.5 of cases. MASER routes with 51.3 oracle agreement, outperforming a Random-Forest ablation (43.5 ), with only a single adapter call per question. Introduction sec:intro Embodied intelligence relies on modalities beyond images. An autonomous agent operating in an outdoor scene must answer reasoning questions such as ``Is the tall building to the left of the signage?'' or ``How many vehicles are within 20 meters?''. These are questions that demand geometric spatial reasoning and depth understanding that RGB images cannot unanimously cover. Modern VLMs bai2023qwen,liu2024llava excel at image-grounded question-answering tasks but struggle to generalize over point cloud, depth or pose cues ye2023open3dvqa . An obvious solution is parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), that is given a frozen VLM backbone, train a separate low-rank adapter over the training data. However, yet another crucial question arises: which adapter should be activated for a given question? One option would be to run all modality adapters and aggregate -- which is computationally expensive when modality count increases. The polar opposite would be to randomly select an adapter which is cheap but unstable accuracy. Therefore, it is evident that a routing policy remains a necessity that maps a question to its best modality adapter efficiently. To address this, we propose MASER, a modality-routing framework for embodied 3D VQA tasks. Our main contributions are as follows: Five DoRA~ liu2024dora adapters of Qwen2-VL-2B are fine-tuned independently on inputs of different modalities while sharing a single backbone that is switched during inference. A frozen sentence transformer (SBERT~ reimers2019sentence ) encodes the question into a 384-dimensional semantic embedding. A three-layer MLP maps this embedding to a probability distribution over the five adapters. We analyze the latency of using different modal adapters and provide a speed-accuracy trade-off through our proposed method. Related Work sec:related Embodied 3D Visual QA. Open3DVQA~ ye2023open3dvqa dataset is a major benchmark for embodied scene understanding which combines RGB, depth, pointcloud and pose data across different scenes. Prior work on 3D question-answering azuma2022scanqa,ma2022sqa3d focuses on indoor settings with structured depth sensors. To validate our hypothesis, we have chosen this benchmark which contains considerably high modality count. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)~ hu2022lora and its variants reduce trainable parameters by decomposing weight updates into low-rank matrices. DoRA~ liu2024dora further decomposes weights into magnitude and direction, improving stability and convergence. IA ~ liu2022few scales activations with learned vectors, achieving strong performance at extreme parameter budgets. We use DoRA throughout, as it consistently outperformed LoRA and IA in our preliminary ablations on the Open3D-VQA dataset. Mixture-of-Experts and Adapter Routing. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)~ jacobs1991adaptive,shazeer2017outrageously works by routing tokens or samples to specialized networks present in a single model. Recent work applies MoE to language model fine-tuning via LoRAMoE~ dou2024loramoe and MoLoRA~ zadouri2024pushing , which gate among multiple LoRA matrices within one model. Methodology sec:method MASER consists of three stages: (1) training modality-specific adapters, (2) collecting oracle routing labels and training a neural router, and (3) confidence-based cascade inference. Modality-Specific Adapters sec:method:adapters Let denote the five sensor modalities that we focus on in the Open3D-VQA dataset. We train one DoRA adapter per modality , all sharing a frozen backbone . We perform modality engineering to enable VLM specific processing. The image frames are resized to and passed directly to the vision encoder. We further summarize pointcloud data as a structured text string encoding the centroid, point count and vertical extent . The raw depth map is min-max normalized to and converted to a three-channel grayscale image. The pose and text modalities are processed with no additional feature engineering. Oracle Data Collection and Neural Router Training sec:method:router Oracle label construction. For each question in the router training split (15 of Open3D-VQA), we run all five adapters and score each prediction against the ground-truth answer using a judge: Initially, we apply a naive exact-match check, and if it fails, a lightweight LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) evaluates semantic equivalence. The oracle label for question is the cost-penalised best modality: where is the latency of adapter on question , and controls the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. On our routing split this yields the following oracle label distribution, which directly motivates routing: point cloud (51.5 ), depth (7.9 ), text (19.2 ), image (6.2 ), pose (15.2 ). Experiments sec:experiments Dataset and Evaluation Protocol sec:exp:data Dataset: We evaluate on Open3D-VQA~ ye2023open3dvqa , which contains 73 , 324 QA pairs across four different scene types: EmbodiedCity (Wuhan), RealworldUAV (Residence), UrbanScene (Residence), and WildUAV (Wild). Each sample provides an RGB image, a depth map (.npy), a point cloud (.npy), a camera pose (JSON), and a natural-language answer. We partition samples using a fixed random seed (42) into three splits: adapter-train (70 , 51 , 326 samples), router-train (15 , 10 , 998 samples), and test (15 , 11 , 000 samples). All adapters use Qwen~ wang2024qwen2 as the frozen backbone. Each DoRA adapter adds approximately 36M trainable parameters ( of the 2B backbone). Scoring Metric: Adapter responses are evaluated with a hybrid judge (Eq.~ eq:judge ): exact match accuracy and semantic equivalence scoring with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct when exact match fails. We report judge-based accuracy as the primary metric, which we call JudgeAcc. Discussion and Limitations sec:exp:discussion Table tab:main reveals that our proposed methodology achieves the lowest latency (1.56\,s/Q). MASER outperforms unimodal adapters including Text, Pose and Pointcloud. However, the accuracy does not exceed the Image-only adapter (47.0 vs.\ 63.5 ). We attribute this to the dense spatial information the image adapter learns given a frozen VLM backbone. The oracle label construction (Eq.~ eq:oracle ) penalises slow adapters via . Image and depth adapters demand full Vision Transformer encoding and are slower, so the oracle labels assign them lower scores. Thus, the router learns to route only 11.5 of queries to the image adapter, compared to the 20 it would receive by chance. The router is given only the question data as input. It cannot determine whether the scene's point cloud is sparse or whether the RGB image provides a clear view. The per-class recall table (Table~ tab:confusion_summary ) confirms this: depth (0.00 recall) and image (16 recall) questions have weak semantic signatures. Therefore, when the router assigns such questions to pointcloud or pose instead of image adapters, the accuracy reduces. The cascade provides identical JudgeAcc (47.0 ) because the router confidence is consistently high ( for 94 of queries), meaning the second adapter is rarely invoked. This further confirms that the MLP router is decisive, though it also suggests should be tuned more aggressively in future work. Despite these limitations, MASER's lowest latency demonstrates that our routing approach is sound: when inference speed is the primary constraint in real-time cases such as edge robotics and real-time UAV, routing to cheaper non-visual modalities is a viable operating point. Future Work sec:exp:future_work Our study opens two directions for adaptive routing in embodied agents. First, we observed that raw oracle labels conflate modality with adapter quality. Future work must disentangle these by defining oracle labels relative to the base model's performance. We aim to understand the superior performance of visual image adapters and provide improved routing policy in multiple VQA datasets. Secondly, the router currently relies solely on question text, leading to visual modality confusion. Providing the router with a visual feature encoder would assist resolve visual disparities without requiring additional adapter passes. Moreover, our router training uses only 1 , 000 samples, which was chosen for computational efficiency to validate our approach. Scaling to the full train split (10 , 998 samples) would likely improve routing accuracy further. Additionally, the point-cloud summary is a coarse numerical descriptor. AI.tldr: MASER 提出一种基于问题语义的轻量级路由机制，在多模态适配器间动态选择最优推理路径，实现 3D 具身 VQA 任务中的效率–准确率权衡。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有 VLM 针对单一模态微调，忽略问题语义可能指向其他更优模态。
2. 盲目运行所有适配器计算开销大，随机选择则性能不稳定，需要高效路由策略。
3. 单一模态适配器无通用最优解，点云在过半样例中表现最佳，凸显模态选择的重要性。
AI.method:
1. 核心思路：冻结共享 VLM 主干，为不同模态训练独立 DoRA 适配器，并训练轻量 MLP 路由器基于问题文本语义选择适配器。
2. 路由器输入为冻结 SBERT 编码的问题嵌入，输出适配器概率分布，训练使用带类权重的交叉熵损失，标签来源于各适配器在验证集上的带延迟惩罚的准确率。
3. 引入置信度级联：路由器置信度低于阈值时同时调用前两个适配器，通过 LLM 判定最终答案，提升对视觉模态问题的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 Open3D-VQA 基准上验证，路由器与最优适配器的一致率达到 51.3%，优于随机森林基线；端到端 JudgeAcc 与点云适配器相当，同时显著降低推理延迟；但路由器对深度与图像类问题召回率低，导致性能局限。
AI.conclusion:
1. 核心价值：证明了问题语义可用于预测最优模态，无需视觉输入即可实现高效路由，在延迟敏感场景有实用价值。
2. 主要限制：路由器仅依赖问题文本，缺乏场景视觉特征，难以识别图像或深度占优的问题，导致对这些模态的召回率不足；置信度级联几乎未被触发，阈值设计未能有效补偿。
3. 关键获致：语义路由在非视觉模态上效果明确，但对视觉模态的区分仍需引入轻量视觉编码器或更精细的代价函数设计。
